notes: DebtFree has a new look. The app is now graphite and white, with a highlighter yellow that marks your progress and the next thing to tap. Your debts, plan and settings are exactly as they were, in both the light and dark themes.

Each color now means one thing. Green is good news, like the interest you’re saving. Blue is worth a look, like the interest you’re paying now or a card that’s close to its limit. Red is kept for real problems.
A new typeface, Atkinson Hyperlegible, made to be easy to read. Every number is clearer, and a zero has a slash through it so it can’t be mistaken for an 8.
Labels are in plain sentence case instead of spaced-out capitals, and the glow effects are gone, so each screen is calmer.
A new app icon, and each kind of debt (credit card, student loan, car loan, personal loan, mortgage) has its own color on your debt cards and the by-account bar.
